notes: The complete invariant ansatz is P=c M with c nonzero. Every restricted gradient and every jet is multiplied by the same unit c. The Jacobian ideal, its differential closure and the fixed Casimir graph ideal are identical for all nonzero c, including their T filtrations. Thus no coefficient-sensitive rank drop exists within this ansatz; c=0 is excluded.

The QQ minimal second module at (4,1) has total dimension 1 and zero-weight multiplicity 1. Its residual-flavor singlet multiplicity is 1, confirmed by complete character decomposition and the Weyl denominator. A complete resolution independently agrees in the required window. The full slice presentation and original target are retained; index checks are unchanged.
